'''Wetyin's Way''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]. It extended from [[Jovan III]] at the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] and terminated at [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]] outside [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]].

[[Planet/Legends|Worlds]] along the Way included [[Glade]] and [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]].
